responsibility: This file implements a small address-list container for the mc-boot toolchain runtime using linked fixed-size blocks of void * entries. It owns list creation, destruction, append, indexed lookup, membership tests, duplicate suppression, removal, traversal by callback, and whole-list duplication, and is used as a generic pointer collection distinct from the otherwise nearly identical lists module by defining its own alists types and callback interface.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the implementation half of the Galists pair: it defines the internal block-linked alist node layout and the actual list operations using Storage allocation, whereas gcc/m2/mc-boot/Galists.h exposes only the opaque alists_alist handle, callback type, and function declarations.
